105:1.translation: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant

105:2.translation: Did He not make their plan into misguidance

105:3.translation: And He sent against them birds in flocks

105:4.translation: Striking them with stones of hard clay

105:5.translation: And He made them like eaten straw

18:97.translation: So Gog and Magog were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration

18:98.translation: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true
